added: Authors and Sources managers, under Settings › General › Library, list every author and every published source with the number of dances that use it. As in the Tags manager you can search, show only the entries no dance uses, and sort by name or by number of dances. From an entry's menu you can rename it, merge it into another, or edit its details; an entry no dance uses can also be deleted. Rename, merge and delete offer Undo.

Merging two authors or two sources keeps the details of the one you merge into and fills any it leaves empty from the other. Where both hold different values, the app lists the ones it will drop and asks first. For a source, a dance that cited both keeps one citation, with an empty page or number filled from the other.
A source's row shows its author and year, so sources with the same title can be told apart.
changed: Renaming an author to a name another author already has, in the dance editor or the Authors manager, now offers to merge the two instead of refusing. The dance being edited follows the merge, and Undo puts both authors back.

added: `ReferenceEditRepository.deleteUnused` deletes an author or source no live dance cites, with Undo, and bumps any dance in Recently deleted that still cites it.
`authorMergeConflicts` and `sourceMergeConflicts` list the values a merge will drop.
changed: A source merge fills an empty page or number on the citation a dance keeps from the citation it drops, and its Undo empties them again.
